# JavaScript

`.helmsman/tools/eslint/index.js` is opt-in. When a root config references it, the commit fails on `eval`, a skipped or focused test, and the ceilings in that file. Lower a number to tighten. Do not raise one so a commit passes. Do not install ESLint when the repo has no ESLint config, or when `make check` or a root `package.json` `check` script already runs. A repo on `tsc --noEmit` uses `.helmsman/tools/tsc` only if it opts in. When ESLint is opted in, do not add a second lint config beside it.

`.helmsman/tools/knip` is optional. It is not assumed to already exist. When a root Knip config or a `knip` dependency is wired, unused files, unused exports, unused dependencies, and import cycles fail the commit. Rust does not use it.
